question: Can a numerically equivalent PyTorch intra-op thread count reduce exact iDDPM DSM update time enough to clear the predeclared 12-second endpoint resource gate?

trial.data: one fixed batch of 1000 samples from N(0, 256 v_max v_max^T)
trial.optimizer: Adam at 1e-4 with gradient clipping at 1

safe_condition: Both repetitions must have exactly the same final model SHA-256 as the 32-thread reference and maximum loss relative error <= 1e-7.
selection: Among safe thread counts only, select the smallest median time over the four timed updates. Timing never affects a claim verdict or metric.
integrity_failure: Exit nonzero for missing trials, non-finite loss/timing, checker disagreement, non-unit SAD direction, GPU use, or a negative control that is not rejected.
